Confirmed North America markets include Northern Virginia, Chicago, Dallas, Phoenix, Salt Lake City, Maryland, Ohio, Atlanta, Hillsboro, and Abernathy, Texas, matching every state where this registry lists an Aligned facility (Virginia, Illinois, and Texas). The company emphasizes closed loop cooling to reduce water consumption, 100 percent renewable energy matching in North America, and adaptive modular design, and recently broke ground on Project Caprock, described as a sustainable 540 megawatt next generation data center campus in Northwest Texas. No founding date, headquarters address, ownership structure such as a possible Macquarie Asset Management connection, or acquisition history, and no building specific address or individual MW figures for this particular registry row, were located in available sourcing this session.
